coords_note: lat/lng from OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookups of each venue; see coords_source per item.

items.name: Mercado de San Miguel
items.times: Sun–Thu 10:00–24:00. Fri, Sat and holiday eves 10:00–01:00. So Oct 30 and 31 run late.
items.address: Plaza de San Miguel, s/n, 28005 Madrid
items.why_go: A glass-and-iron 1916 market packed with tapas, oyster and vermouth stalls next to Plaza Mayor.
items.notes: Gets very crowded in the evening. No specific holiday hours posted for Nov 1; call +34 915 42 49 36 to confirm.

items.name: Mercado de San Antón
items.times: Market stalls Mon–Sat 9:30–21:30. Gastro stalls daily 12:00–24:00. Restaurant daily 13:00–01:00.
items.why_go: Three floors in Chueca: fresh market, ready-to-eat stalls and a top-floor restaurant and terrace.
items.notes: Fresh-food stalls are closed Sunday (Nov 1); gastro stalls and restaurant stay open daily. No holiday hours posted.

items.name: Mercado de San Fernando
items.times: Per Time Out: Tue–Thu 9:00–21:00, Sat 9:00–17:00, Sun 10:00–17:00. Friday hours not listed.
items.why_go: A local neighborhood market with craft beer, food stalls and a books-by-weight shop.
items.notes: Hours are from Time Out, not the market's own site; Friday hours not found. The market blog mentions a Day of the Dead altar on Oct 31 in past years, but a 2026 event is not confirmed.

items.name: Buñuelos de viento at La Mallorquina
items.times: Not found (check the shop).
items.address: Puerta del Sol, 8, 28013 Madrid (also Velázquez 39 and Arapiles 1)
items.why_go: A bakery from 1894 that fries its All Saints buñuelos the same day it sells them.
items.notes: New 2026 flavors are raspberry and pistachio, per Guía del Ocio. Expect lines near Nov 1. Huesos de santo (marzipan 'saints' bones') are sold alongside.

items.name: Huesos de santo at Antigua Pastelería del Pozo
items.times: Not found (check the shop).
items.why_go: Madrid's oldest bakery (1830) makes filled buñuelos and marzipan huesos de santo for All Saints.
items.notes: Small shop. Opening on Sun Nov 1 not confirmed.

items.name: All Saints sweets at El Riojano
items.times: Not found (check the shop).
items.why_go: An 1855 confectioner with a period interior that sells buñuelos and huesos de santo for a short season.
items.notes: Announced its 2026 buñuelos and huesos on Oct 13, 2026, for a limited time only. Go early in the week.

items.name: Paella or tapas cooking class at Cooking Point
items.times: Paella class 10:00–14:00 (with market visit). Tapas class 17:30–21:30. Mon–Sat only.
items.why_go: Hands-on class where you cook paella or tapas with a local chef and eat what you make.
items.notes: No classes on Sunday (Nov 1). Availability for these dates not confirmed; book ahead. Metro Antón Martín (L1).

items.name: Suma Flamenca festival: final week at Teatros del Canal
items.times: Oct 28 Jesús Carmona 'UnYdos' 20:30. Oct 29 Farruquito Sexteto Flamenco 20:30. Oct 30 Rocío Molina 'Caída del cielo' 20:30. Oct 31 Estévez & Paños 'Doncellas' 20:30. Nov 1 Israel Fernández, cante recital 19:30.
items.venue: Teatros del Canal, Sala Roja Concha Velasco
items.price: Not found (not on the festival ticket page)
items.why_go: Top flamenco stars in a modern theater during the closing week of Madrid's big flamenco festival.
items.notes: Festival runs to Nov 1. Other shows those nights are outside central Madrid (El Escorial, La Cabrera) or in Vallecas (Capullo de Jerez Oct 31 20:00, Aurora Vargas Nov 1 19:00 at Centro Cultural Paco Rabal). Box office +34 913 089 999. Metro Canal (L2/L7).

items.name: Flamenco Real: Arcángel at Teatro Real
items.times: Oct 28 21:00 (premiere). Oct 29 and 30 20:00.
items.address: Plaza de Isabel II, s/n, 28013 Madrid
items.why_go: One of today's great flamenco singers in an intimate ballroom inside the opera house.
items.notes: Teatro Real's main stage has no opera Oct 28–Nov 1; Le Nozze di Figaro starts Nov 10. Small room, so book soon.

items.name: Flamenco show at Corral de la Morería
items.times: Second show 21:30 (dinner from 21:10). Earlier show time not found.
items.price: Show only €95.90 (dinner extra; other package prices not found)
items.why_go: Madrid's most famous tablao, open since 1956, with a dinner option.
items.notes: Open daily per visitmadrid.es. Limited seats and high demand; book early. Dress code not found. Metro Ópera or La Latina.

items.name: Flamenco show at Tablao Cardamomo
items.times: Four shows daily: 18:00, 19:30, 21:00, 22:30. About one hour.
items.price: Not found (shown on booking calendar; includes one drink)
items.why_go: A central tablao with four shows a night, so it fits around a late dinner.
items.notes: Tapas menu is an add-on. Metro Sol or Sevilla.

items.name: Jazz at Café Central (Ulf Wakenius Organ Trio and more)
items.times: Shows at 20:00 and 22:00. Oct 28 Julia Perminova Quartet. Oct 29 Jive Mother Mary. Oct 30–31 Ulf Wakenius Organ Trio (JazzMadrid). Nov 1 Alicia Tamariz.
items.price: Ulf Wakenius from €29; other nights not found
items.why_go: Madrid's classic jazz club, now in the Ateneo building, with a Swedish guitar great on the weekend.
items.notes: Café Central now lists its address as Calle del Prado 21 (Ateneo), not its old Plaza del Ángel spot. Wakenius tickets: https://madridenvivo.com/evento/jazz-con-sabor-a-club-26-ulf-wakenius-organ-trio-festival-jazzmadrid/

items.name: JazzMadrid at Teatro Albéniz: Lizz Wright, Alfa Mist, Richard Bona
items.times: 20:30 each night. Oct 30 Lizz Wright. Oct 31 Alfa Mist. Nov 1 Richard Bona Quintet.
items.price: Lizz Wright from €25. Alfa Mist from €28. Richard Bona from €25.
items.why_go: Three big international jazz names on three nights in a central theater, part of the JazzMadrid festival.
items.notes: JazzMadrid runs Oct 2–Nov 30, 2026. Lizz Wright: https://villanosdeljazz.es/evento/lizz-wright-3/  Alfa Mist: https://villanosdeljazz.es/evento/alfa-mist-2/

items.name: Ibrahim Maalouf & The Trumpets of Michel-Ange Vol. 2
items.address: Paseo Bajo de la Virgen del Puerto, s/n, 28005 Madrid
items.why_go: The French-Lebanese trumpet star brings his brass-heavy jazz show to a classic Madrid club.
items.notes: Part of JazzMadrid. Standing club venue (assumed; not confirmed). Street number not found.

items.name: London Philharmonic, Edward Gardner, Julia Fischer
items.times: 19:30 (per the Auditorio; LPO site says 20:00 for Oct 28). Oct 28: Casals, Brahms Double Concerto, Sibelius 5. Oct 29: Brahms, Tchaikovsky.
items.venue: Auditorio Nacional de Música, Sala Sinfónica
items.address: Calle del Príncipe de Vergara, 146, 28002 Madrid
items.why_go: A top London orchestra with star violinist Julia Fischer in Spain's main concert hall.
items.notes: Ibermúsica series. Confirm start time on the ticket. Oct 29 program details from Bachtrack only.

items.name: Spanish National Orchestra and Choir: Kent Nagano, Debussy and Falla's Atlàntida
items.times: Fri Oct 30 19:30. Sat Oct 31 19:30. Sun Nov 1 11:30.
items.venue: Auditorio Nacional de Música, Sala Sinfónica
items.address: Calle del Príncipe de Vergara, 146, 28002 Madrid
items.why_go: Debussy's La Mer and a selection from Falla's epic Atlàntida, plus a world-premiere Debussy orchestration.
items.notes: Soloists Nuria Rial, Maite Beaumont, José Antonio López, with Barcelona Ars Nova. The Sunday morning show works on the holiday. Direct ticket link not found.

items.name: Morat in concert
items.address: Not found in a cited listing (Movistar Arena, Goya area, 28009 Madrid per OpenStreetMap)
items.why_go: The Colombian pop-folk band plays a multi-night arena run, the biggest pop show in town these dates.
items.notes: Sold via Ticketmaster, El Corte Inglés, Entradas.com and Fever. No other arena shows found Oct 29 or Nov 1.

items.name: Thyssen: Mauritshuis masterpieces, Dalí and Kenny Scharf
items.why_go: Twenty-five Dutch masterpieces on loan from The Hague, plus a new show on Dalí and Freud.
items.notes: On view: Mauritshuis ♥ Thyssen (Oct 9, 2026–Jan 10, 2027), El universo freudiano de Dalí (Oct 20, 2026–Jan 24, 2027), Kenny Scharf (Sep 29, 2026–Jan 17, 2027). Free Mondays 12:00–16:00 (no Monday in this trip window).

items.name: Prado Museum and 'Ricardo de Madrazo: drawings and watercolors'
items.price: €15 general, €7.50 reduced. Free last two hours (collection only).
items.why_go: Velázquez, Goya and Bosch, plus a new show of Ricardo de Madrazo's drawings (Oct 13, 2026–Jan 17, 2027).
items.notes: Open Nov 1 on Sunday hours; Prado closes only Jan 1, May 1 and Dec 25. Free-hour lines are long; arrive early. Temporary shows half price during free hours. Full 2026 exhibition list not confirmed (official site would not load).

items.name: Reina Sofía: Eli Cortiñas, Manolo Millares and the Guernica collection
items.times: Mon and Wed–Sat 10:00–21:00. Sun 10:00–14:30. Closed Tuesday. Free Mon/Wed–Sat 19:00–21:00 and Sun 12:30–14:30.
items.venue: Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía
items.why_go: Picasso's Guernica plus new shows by Eli Cortiñas and Fernando Sánchez Castillo, free in the evening.
items.notes: On view: Eli Cortiñas 'La máquina sueña con humo' (Sep 23, 2026–Mar 8, 2027), Fernando Sánchez Castillo 'La Perla Peregrina' (to Mar 8, 2027), Manolo Millares 'Personaje caído I' (to Feb 16, 2027). Nov 1 is a Sunday, so it closes at 14:30.

items.name: Andrea Canepa's 'Fardo' at the Palacio de Cristal
items.times: Palace winter hours 10:00–18:00 (Time Out; Nov–Feb). Retiro Park 6:00–22:00 Oct–Mar.
items.address: Paseo de la República de Cuba, 4, 28009 Madrid
items.why_go: A huge colorful textile wraps the glass palace in the Retiro, a free outdoor art stop.
items.notes: Runs Jan 13, 2026–Jan 1, 2027 (Reina Sofía project during restoration). Exact Oct hours not confirmed; may close in rain.

items.name: 'La otra orilla de la vanguardia' at Fundación MAPFRE
items.times: Tue–Sat 11:00–20:00. Sun and holidays 11:00–19:00.
items.price: €5 general, €3 reduced. Free on non-holiday Tuesdays (none fall in this window).
items.why_go: How avant-garde artists were shaped by art made by psychiatric patients, from Prinzhorn's 1922 book.
items.notes: Runs Sep 24, 2026–Jan 10, 2027. Older MAPFRE listings gave free Mondays; the 2026 listing says Tuesdays.

items.name: 'We Are Nature' at CaixaForum Madrid
items.times: Daily 10:00–20:00, holidays included.
items.why_go: A show on people and nature in the building with the famous vertical garden wall, steps from the Prado.
items.notes: Runs Jun 3, 2026–Mar 7, 2027. Other autumn 2026 CaixaForum shows not confirmed (official site would not load).

items.name: 'La transición estética. España, 1960–2020' at Fundación Juan March
items.times: Mon–Sat and holidays 10:00–20:00. Sun 10:00–14:00.
items.why_go: A free show on how modern art reached Spain from 1960 to 2020, with Warhol, Kandinsky and Matisse.
items.notes: Opening date differs by source: Oct 16 (esmadrid) or Oct 28 (Time Out). Either way it is open these dates. Runs to Jan 10, 2027. Nov 1 is a Sunday, so it closes at 14:00. Metro Núñez de Balboa.

items.name: MADHORROR horror culture festival (Halloween)
items.times: Not found
items.why_go: First edition of a giant horror fest with effects exhibits, a zombie march and guests like Robert Englund.
items.notes: Exhibits on Pan's Labyrinth effects and 40 years of Aliens. Not recommended for under-18s. Metro Campo de las Naciones (L8). IFEMA's FAQ page oddly shows 2027 dates; Time Out and IFEMA's Oct 2026 guide give Oct 30–Nov 2, 2026.

city_notes.note: Nov 1 (All Saints) falls on a Sunday in 2026. The Madrid region moves the day off to Monday, Nov 2, making a long weekend.
Big museums stay open on Nov 1 on Sunday hours: Prado 10:00–19:00, Reina Sofía 10:00–14:30, Juan March 10:00–14:00. Thyssen, CaixaForum and MAPFRE keep normal Sunday/holiday hours.
Many shopping centers in the Madrid area open on Sundays and holidays, including Nov 1, 2026. Small family shops and bakeries may close; confirm first.
Locals eat lunch 13:30–15:30 and dinner usually 21:00–22:30. Book dinner for 21:00 or later to match the crowd.
Metro runs daily 6:00–1:30. Buy a reusable Tarjeta Multi (€2.50) or a 1–7 day Tourist Travel Pass. Line 8 reaches airport T4 in under 20 minutes.
Two famous names are closed: Bogui Jazz and Casa Patas tablao are both marked closed by Time Out. Use Café Central and Corral de la Morería or Cardamomo instead.
